LIFE RAFT INFLATION
1. OXYGEN MASK LOCATION
Oxygen masks are stored in
a compartment above each
row of passenger seats.
Should oxygen be required,
the compartment door
will open automatically
and oxygen masks will
be presented on the door.
2. USING THE MASK
Should oxygen masks appear,
remain seated. Grasp nearest
mask and remove it from its
holder, at the same time pulling free the cord connect-
ing mask to the compartment. This will permit the
oxygen to flow. Place mask over nose and mouth and
breathe normally. Continue to use oxygen until other-
wise directed by a crew member.
3. ADJUSTING THE
MASK
The oxygen mask has an
adjustable head strap to
provide a comfortable fit.
If mask is too tight, hold mask in position and pul
gently on headband with free hand. If mask is toc
loose, pull tabs located where headband connects
to oxygen mask.

WELCOME ABOARD!
Pacific East Air has taken every precaution to
ensure your safety during this flight and although we
de not anticipate any emergencies, this short
brochure has been prepared for your benefit. We
would appreciate it if you would take the time to
read this brochure and familiarize yourself with the
safety features on board our aircraft, then sit back,
relax, and enjoy the flight.

Our aircraft is fully equipped with emergency exits
and facilities as illustrated on the diagram.
Placards are at each exit giving directions as to
their use. All doors have escape slides - follow
the directions of your flight crew in their use.

LIFE VESTS
1. Unsnap RED strap and remove
Life Vest from under front of seat.
2. Don Life Vest over head.
3. Grasp pull straps from behind waist
and bring around to front.
4. Snap "D" rings on pull straps to
harness buckles on front of Life Vest.
5. Pull outward on straps until Vest is
snug around waist.
WARNING!
DO NOT INFLATE LIFE VEST
INSIDE AIRCRAFT
6. Inflate by sharp jerk on two RED
inflation knobs.
7. Oral inflation can be accomplished by
blowing into oral inflation tubes on each
side of Life Vest.
INFANT LIFE VEST
1. Obtain from flight attendant.
2. Don Life Vest
over infant's head.
3. Bring pull straps
through legs from back
and snap "D" rings into
harness buckles.
4. Pull straps until
Vest is snug.
6. Inflate by
sharp jerk
on RED
inflation
knob.
5. Tie neck
strap.
SURVIVOR LOCATER LIGHT
A light located on the shoulder
of each Life Vest is illuminated,
by a water-activated battery
mounted just above the
harness buckles. At
night remove the
plastic plugs attached
to battery and light will
illuminate when battery
submerges in water.
